description:
Collect and process observability data at the edge

Cribl Edge helps you collect and process observability data - logs, metrics, and application data - in real time, from your Linux, Windows, and macOS machines, apps, or microservices, and deliver them to Cribl Stream or any supported destination.
With Cribl Edge you can:
- Automatically discover and collect host, container, and application metrics, as well as logs, on endpoints.
- Process data with Functions and Pipelines.
- Forward data to any of the many supported destinations.
- Easily manage configurations while maintaining version control.
- Teleport to the edge for local preview and configuration validation.
This release corrects three critical issues found in Cribl Edge 4.20.0:
- Microsoft Sentinel Destinations created on a prior version with an inline OAuth secret failed authentication after upgrade because Cribl sent the encrypted secret to Microsoft. For more information, see the known issue. (CRIBL-45304)
- Saving TLS settings for an Outpost Group in Distributed Settings > TLS Settings failed validation because the UI sent an empty lakeAzure object. For more information, see the known issue. (CRIBL-45296)
- On a 4.20.0 Leader, Edge Nodes running 4.19.x discarded every event that reached an Event Breaker Function in a Pipeline. For more information, see the known issue. (CRIBL-45467)
See the Cribl Edge 4.20.0 release notes for the latest feature and correction updates.
